description: This file implements the WindowManagerConnector class, which manages interactions with a window manager service, including initialization, display creation, and retrieving display info within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: A class that manages connection and communication with the window manager service, including display creation and info retrieval.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector::WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: A nested class handling window manager notifications, such as user inactivity events.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::WindowManagerConnector
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and setting up the connector.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by querying the window manager interface and registering for notifications.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::releasePlugin
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters from the window manager.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display with specified parameters via the window manager.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::isPluginInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the plugin has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display information such as XDG directory and Wayland display name.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector::WindowManagerNotification::OnUserInactivity
methods.description: Handles user inactivity notifications from the window manager.
